assets.purpose: 商店街・開店編の Before（シャッター通り）。wrapUp の Before / エリア背景 / ch1 ヘッダの3役
assets.prompt:
Rounded 3D clay / plasticine miniature diorama style, handcrafted soft texture,
bright warm colors, soft diagonal lighting, modern and slightly stylish (for Japanese kids
aged 9-12 — NOT babyish, NOT old-fashioned), consistent claymation material for people,
buildings, tools and backgrounds. Figures around 2.5-3 heads tall with simplified hands.
NO readable text, NO numbers, NO letters, NO logos, NO watermark anywhere in the image.
NO photorealism, NO real-brand or real-person likeness, NO scary or dirty expression.
Keep every important element inside the central 70% (mobile crop safety).
Scene: A small quiet Japanese shopping street (shotengai). A row of three small shopfronts seen straight-on: the middle one is a slightly larger former diner, ALL THREE have their roller shutters fully closed. The street is clean but lonely and quiet, no people or just one distant figure. Daytime, soft warm light, but the mood is a bit wistful.
Role in game: 商店街・開店編の Before（シャッター通り）。wrapUp の Before / エリア背景 / ch1 ヘッダの3役
Camera / composition: Eye-level street view, the three-shop row fills the frame width, entire facades visible with sky strip above and street strip below. Leave 8% safe margin all around. This image will be compared to an AFTER image later, so keep the architecture simple and memorable.
Must include: three adjacent small shopfronts; closed roller shutters on all three; the middle shop slightly larger with a small awning (former diner); paved shotengai street
Must NOT include: readable text or letters on any sign; cars blocking the buildings; people crowds; rain or night
Aspect ratio: 4:3 (compose for this frame).
qa_issues: 右奥の小さな人物が画面端に近く、モバイル表示では切れる可能性がある — 非主要要素なので意味は維持されるが、シリーズの見切れ回避基準にはわずかに弱い
周辺背景の被写界深度がやや写真的に強い — クレイジオラマとして成立しているものの、シリーズ統一では背景も少し均質な粘土感に寄せる余地がある
3店舗のシャッターが暗く似た形状で連続している — シャッター通りの状態は明快だが、小さいヘッダ表示では各店舗の識別性がやや下がる

assets.purpose: 商店街・開店編の After（シャッターが1枚開いた）。wrapUp の After
assets.prompt:
Rounded 3D clay / plasticine miniature diorama style, handcrafted soft texture,
bright warm colors, soft diagonal lighting, modern and slightly stylish (for Japanese kids
aged 9-12 — NOT babyish, NOT old-fashioned), consistent claymation material for people,
buildings, tools and backgrounds. Figures around 2.5-3 heads tall with simplified hands.
NO readable text, NO numbers, NO letters, NO logos, NO watermark anywhere in the image.
NO photorealism, NO real-brand or real-person likeness, NO scary or dirty expression.
Keep every important element inside the central 70% (mobile crop safety).
Scene: THE SAME small Japanese shopping street as the reference image: same three shopfronts, same camera, same composition, same weather and palette. The ONLY change: the middle former-diner shop is now OPEN as a warm small teishoku diner — shutter up, warm light from inside, a simple noren curtain (no readable text), a small potted plant by the door, and two or three happy customers near the entrance. The two neighboring shops still have closed shutters.
Role in game: 商店街・開店編の After（シャッターが1枚開いた）。wrapUp の After
Camera / composition: Identical camera and framing to the reference BEFORE image. Do not move, redesign or recolor the buildings; only open the middle shop and add the life around it.
Must include: same three shopfronts as reference; middle shop open with warm interior light; plain noren curtain without text; 2-3 customers (varied ages, no gender stereotype); closed shutters on both neighbors
Must NOT include: readable text or letters; changing the neighboring shops; different camera angle; night scene
Aspect ratio: 4:3 (compose for this frame).
qa_issues: AFTERの店内がテーブル中心の汎用的な飲食店に見え、定食屋と即断できる料理・配膳盆・厨房要素が弱い — 意図した業態の伝達精度がやや低い
AFTERの人物3人が入口前に横並びで集まり、開いた店内の中央下部を一部隠している — 小さい画面では開店後の変化が人物会話シーンとして先に読まれやすい
AFTERの子どもと成人は概ねクレイ調で自然だが、基準の2.5〜3頭身よりわずかに高めに見える — シリーズ人物との頭身統一に軽微な差がある

assets.purpose: 商店街・開店編エリア導入（sceneMap.opening）の物語の顔。将来: 会話/discovery/E画面への展開候補
assets.prompt:
Rounded 3D clay / plasticine miniature diorama style, handcrafted soft texture,
bright warm colors, soft diagonal lighting, modern and slightly stylish (for Japanese kids
aged 9-12 — NOT babyish, NOT old-fashioned), consistent claymation material for people,
buildings, tools and backgrounds. Figures around 2.5-3 heads tall with simplified hands.
NO readable text, NO numbers, NO letters, NO logos, NO watermark anywhere in the image.
NO photorealism, NO real-brand or real-person likeness, NO scary or dirty expression.
Keep every important element inside the central 70% (mobile crop safety).
Scene: A friendly Japanese adult in their early 30s who dreams of opening a small teishoku (set-meal) diner. Warm, hopeful smile. Wearing a clean modern navy apron over casual clothes, holding a round wooden serving tray with a small clay bowl of rice and a tiny miso soup bowl on it (clearly a diner cook-to-be). Gender-ambiguous styling, short neat hair.
Role in game: 5章を貫くNPCハルさん（定食屋を開きたい人）の立ち絵。会話・discovery・E画面で反復登場
Camera / composition: UPPER BODY ONLY (waist-up), centered, LOTS of empty margin: the head top must be well below the top edge (at least 15% headroom) and the waist crop well above the bottom edge. Plain very light warm background (soft cream). CRITICAL: chibi clay-figure proportions of this series — big round head, small body, about 2.5 heads tall in full (so the visible waist-up is mostly head and chest), simplified mitten-like hands.
Must include: navy apron; round wooden serving tray with rice bowl and miso soup; warm hopeful expression; big-head chibi proportions (2.5-3 heads); generous margins on all sides
Must NOT include: readable text; brand logos; realistic adult proportions (4+ heads tall); full body / legs / shoes; kitchen background clutter; photorealistic skin; elements touching the image edges
Characters: modern, kind adult; series chibi clay proportions (2.5-3 heads), NOT realistic proportions; no gender-stereotyped exaggeration
Aspect ratio: 1:1 (compose for this frame).

PREVIOUS ATTEMPT FAILED QA. Fix these specific problems this time:
- 顔が大きく頬が丸い幼児的な造形で、成人の「ハルさん」より低年齢の少年に見える — 小4〜6年生向けの「幼すぎない、少し大人っぽい」人物表現というMUSTに反する
- 目・鼻・口の単純化と頭部比率が強く、基準の2.5〜3頭身より幼い印象が先行する — 5章を通じて定食屋の開業を目指す人物としての成熟度が伝わりにくい
- エプロンと定食の盆で飲食店志望は明確だが、服装が非常に素朴で現代的なおしゃれ感が弱い — シリーズの対象年齢に合う洗練を少し加える余地がある
- STYLE_CONSISTENCY below threshold: 68
qa_issues: 髪の最上部と胴体下端の余白がやや少ない — UI側で拡大表示や縦長クロップを行うと窮屈に見える可能性がある
基準の人物画像より表面が滑らかで高精細 — 反復登場時に他NPCより少し写実CG寄りに見える可能性がある
定食屋の仕事はエプロン・ご飯・汁物で十分伝わるが、献立の種類が少なく開店準備中という物語情報までは単体で判別しにくい

assets.purpose: 「ごみのゆくえ」エリア探索マップの台紙。左=街の集積所、中央=清掃工場、右=処分場の丘の横断ジオラマに4章ホットスポットが乗る
assets.prompt:
Rounded 3D clay / plasticine miniature diorama style, handcrafted soft texture,
bright warm colors, soft diagonal lighting, modern and slightly stylish (for Japanese kids
aged 9-12 — NOT babyish, NOT old-fashioned), consistent claymation material for people,
buildings, tools and backgrounds. Figures around 2.5-3 heads tall with simplified hands.
NO readable text, NO numbers, NO letters, NO logos, NO watermark anywhere in the image.
NO photorealism, NO real-brand or real-person likeness, NO scary or dirty expression.
Keep every important element inside the central 70% (mobile crop safety).
Scene: One wide miniature diorama showing a Japanese garbage journey from left to right: LEFT a small neighborhood corner with a garbage collection point (a few pale-blue semi-transparent garbage bags neatly placed, green mesh net) and a cute boxy garbage truck; CENTER a clean modern waste-to-energy incineration plant (big boxy hall, one tall slim chimney with a FAINT wisp of white steam, small crane visible through a window); RIGHT a green landfill hill with terraced layers and a tiny monitoring hut. A single winding road connects all three. Bright daytime sky.
Role in game: 「ごみのゆくえ」エリア探索マップの台紙。左=街の集積所、中央=清掃工場、右=処分場の丘の横断ジオラマに4章ホットスポットが乗る
Camera / composition: Slight top-down diorama view (like a toy model on a table), the three zones evenly spaced left/center/right so UI hotspots can sit on each zone plus the road. Generous margins, nothing important near edges. Clean, friendly, NOT dirty or smoky.
Must include: collection point with bags and net; garbage truck; incineration plant with one chimney and faint white steam; green landfill hill with terraces; connecting road
Must NOT include: readable text or signs; black smoke; flames; dirty piles or scattered trash; people in danger
Aspect ratio: 4:3 (compose for this frame).

PREVIOUS ATTEMPT FAILED QA. Fix these specific problems this time:
- 左の住宅・集積所と右の処分場の丘が画面端で切れており、place用途の外周8%セーフマージンを満たさない — 端末比率変更やトリミングで章の目的地が欠落する
- 重要な両端エリアが中央70%の外側にある — モバイル表示では集積所と処分場がさらに小さく、ホットスポットの識別性が落ちる
- 4章に対して視覚的な目的地点は集積所・清掃工場・処分場の3区画が中心で、第4ホットスポット候補が明確でない — 探索順序を画像だけで把握しにくい
- 処分場が整然とした緑の段丘と小屋だけに見え、ごみの埋立・搬入・管理を示す設備が乏しい — 学習用の「処分場」として意味が伝わりにくい
- 集積所の袋や処分場頂上の設備が小さい — 縮小表示では装飾に埋もれ、タップ対象としての可読性が不足する
- 左下の囲いと住宅、右端の丘が不完全な状態でフレーム外へ続く — 完結した横断ジオラマとしてのオブジェクト完全性を損なう
qa_issues: 右側の処分場は配管・道路・植栽の情報量が多い — 小さな画面ではホットスポットと背景要素が競合しやすい
左側に住宅・袋置き場・収集設備が密集している — 「街の集積所」の主対象が一目で特定しにくい
中央下の収集車と施設が近接している — ホットスポットを重ねる位置によっては清掃工場への導線や車両が隠れる
清掃工場の煙突から白煙が出ている — 排煙表現として誤解されないよう、学習内容やUI上で処理工程との関係を補足したい
全体に細部のコントラストが高い — 章アイコンを載せる際は中央70%内に十分な無地余白または視認性の高い台座が必要
